rows.grounds: adjective describing the goddess as undivided or partless
adjective describing the goddess as having parts or manifest
past passive participle indicating traditional declaration

items.question: In what dual modes is the great goddess proclaimed to exist?
premises: The great goddess is addressed directly in the vocative.
She is declared to be without parts.
She is declared to be with parts.
items.inference: The great goddess is proclaimed to exist in both partless and partite modes.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal scope of niṣkalā and sakalā in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: And, O great goddess, you are proclaimed to be both without parts and with parts.
